# Redux event script changes (generated by tools/export_scripts.py)

All 1289 vanilla and 1290 Redux scripts decompile to build/src/*/scripts/ and re-assemble byte-exact. Command set: PokeScriptSDK5 B2W2 definitions (base + the best-matching overlay set per file). Overall 72.6% of Redux script bytes decode as instructions/movement; the rest is kept as raw .hword/.byte (padding, data, and code using undocumented overlay commands).
